title: Figures 6-7: Incoherent combination of single mode lasers (telescope and fiber combiner)
description: Two beam-combination schematics. Figure 6 shows four "single mode lasers" whose green and blue beams reflect off a mirror into a "Pointing Telescope" and converge on a red target spot, captioned "Incoherent Combination of Single Mode Lasers at the Target." Figure 7 shows single mode lasers feeding a bundled fiber combiner whose output passes through a lens and pointing telescope to a red spot, captioned "Incoherent Combination of Single Mode Lasers in a Fiber Combiner."
